notes.title: Demo update
notes.content: [p]Hello friends![/p][olist][*][p]We've been hard at work making a demo version of Vega Chronicle so that folks can start playing and give us feedback to help shape the game. It's almost ready! [/p][/*][*][p]We overhauled the Steam page: go check out the new descriptions, screenshots and gameplay video :)[/p][/*][*][p]Here's a new gif  <3[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/8258e172e51faf3645179790853f981dda8c36d1.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Victory conditions update
notes.content: [p]This week we added multiple victory conditions. Choose your path to glory:[/p][olist][*][p]"Development": Build nexuses in 1/3 of the galaxy's star systems.[/p][/*][*][p]"Science": Complete the technology tree and research Existential manipulation.[/p][/*][*][p]"Culture": Construct 5 monuments.[/p][/*][*][p]"Elimination": Destroy all rival civilizations.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Here's a sneak peek at some of the ships you can build in Vega Chronicle:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/dc30031a4181afffaf7ded6c7e592c7d7fdf6c35.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Diplomacy and trade update
notes.content: [p]Hello friends![/p][olist][*][p]This week we built a diplomacy system where you can trade and negotiate with other space-faring civilizations. We also added more music and sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]We set a goal to start play-testing the demo by the second week of July: we'll be asking for your help![/p][/*][*][p]Here's a sneak-peek at the diplomacy interface:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/c2f94a62d42cb67a7b2248a4d5808c1d8c7c593c.png"][/img][/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Audio update and planets sneak peek
notes.content: [p]We have been working on getting music and sound effects into the game: you'll see game-play with audio soon![/p][p]Here's a sneak peek at some of the of planets you can discover in Vega Chronicle:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646575/545e2ed06689b71b8aae88db31cc0e420e7d9632.png"][/img][/p]
